We have SN2 template reaction_id 82460 seems appropriate: retro_smarts_template shows [c]-[CH2]-[n] -> Br-CH2-c + N... So we can use that.

Now need template for acyl chloride formation from acid (halogen substitution). Search for functional_groups_broken=["carboxylic_acid"], functional_groups_formed=["halide"] maybe.


<thought>Search for a template that converts a carboxylic acid to an acyl chloride (breaks C‑O of acid, forms C‑Cl).
